scope: Approved Phase 2: dedicated NZ campaign, source access/readiness validation, normalized vacancy ingestion and manual capture
steps: Preserve Phase 1 country and live-submission containment; add a separate discovery-only NZ operation capability
Provide explicit NZ preset installation/editing without rewriting UK preferences/campaign content
Validate source metadata and enforce permission, retrieval/storage/AI modes, freshness and server-owned read-only validation at execution boundaries
Carry normalized observations through existing JobSpy, Workday and direct-source adapters with conservative identity/deduplication and original application URLs
Implement safe availability observations and conservative NZ salary interpretation without FX/immigration assumptions
Provide bounded NZ manual capture and discovery UI/API; keep restricted sources reference-only and AI/document generation blocked
Run focused and required isolated verification, record actual coverage/external limitations and commit if permitted
external_dependencies: No validated live NZ source or provider agreement is assumed. Automated coverage remains gated until permission and read-only source acceptance succeed; manual mode is complete independently.
excluded: CV imports and country document generation
